notes: Tuition: the stated 178 EUR/year is the fee shown for a non-EU applicant under the differentiated-fee exemption; Campus France Maroc states the differentiated fee is 2 902 euros pour une année en cycle de Licence, but some institutions exempt foreign students, and the programme page shows the exempted rate without marking it as EU-only. Duration: 3 years is inferred from 'niveau bac+3' (180 ECTS = 3 years). Intake: the 1 Oct – 15 Nov 2026 window is the specific ADIUT Maroc Route for BUT applications via Études en France opened to Moroccan Bac holders, even though the programme is not in Morocco. Teaching language: the programme is taught in French (B2 required) with English as LV1 and Spanish/German as LV2, which are language courses, not the teaching language. Application channel is deliberately omitted per the task: foreign-diploma applicants apply via Études en France / Campus France; Parcoursup applies to French and European Bac holders only.

note.fr: L'admission se fait sur dossier (résultats scolaires, méthodes de travail, savoir-être, motivation, engagements) et comprend des épreuves de sélection : un QCM de culture générale en ligne.
note.en: Admission is based on a portfolio review (academic results, work methods, behaviour, motivation, commitments) and includes selection tests: an online general knowledge multiple-choice test.

evidence.quote: Les candidats convoqués assisteront à un amphi de présentation et passeront un QCM de Culture Générale en ligne.
